title: Institutions
subtitle: Connect hospitals and clinics to see their records about you in MedVault.

public.heading: Connect public institutions
public.intro: One consent connects the public hospitals you choose. Untick any you don't want to share records from.

emptyDescription: Institutions you connect will appear here, with what they share and when.

toast.startFailedDescription: Please try again in a moment.
toast.publicUnreachableDescription: See the list below and try again later.
toast.disconnectedDescription: Its records no longer appear in MedVault.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect {{name}}?
disconnectDialog.description: MedVault loses access straight away and its records disappear from your vault. You can connect it again later.

modal.addDescription: Private clinics are only connected when you add them.
modal.reconnectDescription: Enter your IDNP again so the institution can find your records.
modal.allConnected: Every institution in the catalogue is already connected.

form.idnpHint: The 13-digit personal number on your ID card. Used once to find your records, never stored.
form.agreeOne: I agree to share my records from this institution with MedVault
form.agreeMany: I agree to share my records from these institutions with MedVault
form.consentRequired: Please confirm your consent to continue.

consent.idnp: MedVault sends your IDNP once to each institution listed, only so it can find your records. MedVault never stores your IDNP.
consent.readOnly: Each institution shares read-only access to your diagnoses, lab results, prescriptions, certificates and visits.
consent.live: Records are fetched live when you open them and are not copied into MedVault.
consent.disconnect: You can disconnect an institution at any time; its records then disappear from MedVault straight away.

status.connectingExplanation: Waiting for the institution to confirm.
status.noMatchExplanation: This institution has no records for that IDNP. Nothing was imported.
status.expiredExplanation: Access ended. Reconnect to see these records again.
status.unreachableExplanation: The institution could not be reached.

result.noMatchDescription: The institution has no records for that IDNP. Nothing was imported.
result.batchFailed_one: {{count}} could not be connected. See the list below.
result.batchFailed_other: {{count}} could not be connected. See the list below.
